## Problem and resulting behavior

State the concrete trigger and before/after behavior. R/package/output/phase and exact branch: record. Documentation/bootstrap-only PRs state that no app test/deployment is claimed.

## Verification

Actual commands/cases/fixtures/candidate and evidence; include failures/not-run checks and cause. Clinical/finance oracle and independent required reviewer: record. Link restricted evidence without secrets/private data.

## Risk and rollout

Migration/contracts/old-native compatibility, private/clinical/financial/provider effects and resource/cost/dependency changes. Controlled rollback/reconciliation and consumer handoff. No unrelated scope.

- [ ] Relevant implemented checks executed; documentation green is not app validation.
- [ ] Independent senior/domain review requested where sensitive; no author self-approval.
- [ ] Applicable requirement/phase/member/canonical-test/ADR/runbook/changelog updates are in this PR.
- [ ] No secrets/private records/signing material or raw incident evidence committed.
- [ ] Source/artifact/model/KB/config changes and invalidated gate evidence are identified.
- [ ] Required blockers/public approvals remain explicit; no invented Pass/Go or silent feature cut.

If not applicable, explain why; do not tick boxes for tests or approvals that have not happened. Phase promotion PRs additionally link the signed gate report, frozen manifest/tree/artifact equivalence and postmerge plan.
